fields.title: 4. Competition Timeline Update — New D2D (Satellite-to-Phone) Axis
fields.md:
The October issue's table 1-7 described Amazon Leo only as a "real threat to consumer broadband in 2027–2028." D2D is a revenue item in the Axis A milestone (A-2028-1), and it is the same market as the 800MHz terrestrial network strategy that the October issue described as "the side posing the threat." Starting with this issue, D2D is counted separately.

| Item | SpaceX (Starlink Mobile) | Amazon Leo (+Globalstar) | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| FCC authorization | **15,000-satellite D2D authorization (DA 26-1078, 2026-10-06)** — 2GHz MSS after EchoStar Phase 2 closes (around 2027-11-30) | Globalstar transfer approval (DA 26-1160, 2026-10-27) · C-3 48-satellite U.S. access authorization (mid-October) · own D2D 5,105 satellites **under review** | [DA 26-1078](https://docs.fcc.gov/public/attachments/DA-26-1078A1.txt) · [DA 26-1160](https://docs.fcc.gov/public/attachments/DA-26-1160A1.txt) |
| Spectrum | EchoStar AWS-4/H/AWS-3 ($856M prepayment, before final closing) + Grain 800MHz (closing expected 2027-1H) — October issue 1-2 | Globalstar MSS L/S band (service link about 25MHz) — closing expected 2027 | October issue 1-2 · Section 1 table |
| Current operations | 22 million monthly users (call remarks, no separate revenue disclosure) | About 24 Globalstar satellites — Apple Emergency SOS·Find My, 780,000 devices·120 countries (Light Reading) | October issue 1-2 · [Light Reading 10/27](https://www.lightreading.com/satellite/amazon-leo-s-d2d-plan-ready-for-liftoff-as-fcc-clears-globalstar-buy) |
| Next generation | 2nd-generation Starlink Mobile launch in 2027, service by year-end (**stated**) | Own D2D deployment begins 2028 (Globalstar 8-K · SpaceQ) | Section 3 · Section 1 table |
| Verdict | A-2028-1 **maintained as in progress** | Competition timeline D2D: **real threat after 2028** (with Globalstar assets, a low-capacity Apple-only service) — separate from the consumer broadband verdict (2027–2028) | This issue |

(Source: each cell of the table above · `reports/2026-10.md` 1-2 · 1-7)

**How to read this**: What Amazon gains right now from this approval is **spectrum rights and the Apple contract**, not subscribers or revenue. The SpaceX-side door (DA 26-1078) opened 3 weeks earlier and is larger in scale (15,000 vs. 5,105 applied for), but both companies **remain tied to regulatory and deal conditions until late 2027–2028**. This timeline is exactly why the Axis A 2028 milestone requires separate disclosure of D2D revenue (Source: table above).
